name: Senator’s Stole
body:
Price 8,000 gp; Slot neck or shoulders; CL 3rd; Weight 2 lb.; Aura faint transmutation

DESCRIPTION

This richly embroidered velvet stole can be worn loosely over the shoulders or tightly around the wearer’s neck, denoting their noble rank and helping them navigate the corridors of power with elan. The wearer gains a +5 competence bonus on Diplomacy and Knowledge (nobility) checks, and if they converse with a creature for 1 round they can make a Sense Motive check with advantage to discern whether that person is a member of the nobility, even if in disguise. The wearer becomes a master of convoluted verbiage, gaining a +1 bonus on saving throws against mind-affecting and against language-dependent effects, such as command and suggestion and increasing the save DC by 1 for such language-dependent effects that they use.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 4,000 gp; Feats Craft Wondrous Item, eagle’s splendor
